caption: The drawing depicts a young girl with long blonde hair styled in two braids tied with red ribbons. She is wearing a decorative hat adorned with green foliage and red flowers. Her clothing includes a bright red long-sleeved top with black detailing, over which she has a white apron-like garment that is decorated with blue and red embroidery at the edges. The skirt is red with a flared hem, visible under the apron. She holds a white muff with black spots in her left hand, and a small, lace-trimmed handkerchief in her right hand. On her feet, she wears black ankle boots with buttons. The background is plain and light beige, with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Doll
